comments.value: You can already add this yourself in animation overrides. I agree that current desktop avatars have very unnatural poses nowadays, but again, it can be changed if a creator puts in the effort when making an avatar.

details:
I was talking with a few of my friends, and decided to compare the movements of a full body tracking user (me) attempting to look like a desktop user, and found out why desktop users look so goddamn dead inside, they look like literal statues...

so I've thought of a few fixes...
Fix #1 - Add desktop head swaying, this doesn't have to be massive, but even VR users with just the headset have a little bit of head movement, I personally think desktop users should have their in-game heads move around very slightly (without affecting their view of course), this would be able to fake one effect that was happening when I was trying to act like a desktop user, esentially I was standing with my hands to my sides, however people noticed I was swaying around slightly, like a human should...

Fix #2: IK movement, I personally think desktop users (if they move very slowly or in very small amounts, should use the built in IK system instead of animations, this would mostly be good for those who use controllers, however even keyboard users could do it by tapping A for a split second)
Fix #3 - Item holding animations, I think certain items should have custom positions for where they are held for desktop users, instead of just being held infront of your face in this very weird way that makes literally no sense, instead it should be held in a position that is determined by the item, either relative to the head or chest in some cases...
EG: carrying a gun with two hands, carrying a soda can at around waist height, carrying a box with both hands at chest height, this could even come with the potential of using these for swords or other things (using would trigger another animation, such as swinging, of course for VR users we would just swing naturally)

Fix #4 - Switching between idle animations through a menu, this could fake some of the things VR people do, such as arm crossing or kneeling, these would NOT be like emotes however as we would simply be switching our idle animation, this could also be used for some avatars that have weapons or even used for non full body tracking users to move their feet...

TLDR: Desktop users should NOT be lifeless statues, they look really creepy like that...
PS: I also think that there should be a custom AFK animation that would trigger like an emote after a period of time once input is not detected (such as sitting on the ground or holding up a sign that says I'm AFK)
PPS: as a bonus, maybe try webcam head tracking, that might help with the head movement as well if done properly...
title: Make desktop users look better (and more stuff)
